symptom: 5xx rate rose to 8.1% on POST /v1/charges, settlement queue backing up
cause: Deploy 7c1d004 lowered settlement.pool.size to 20, below the documented floor of 40
resolution: Rolled back the deploy. Error rate normal within 4 minutes.

symptom: 5xx rate 15% with redis-sessions pool timeouts in logs
cause: Traffic growth during a campaign exhausted the connection pool; no deploy involved
resolution: Raised pool size to 60. Restarting was considered and rejected — it would have masked the cause.

symptom: p99 latency 3.2s on GET /cart, no error rate change
cause: Marketing campaign promo banner rendering server-side, as documented in the runbook
resolution: No action. Confirmed against the campaign calendar and closed as expected behaviour.

symptom: 5xx rate spiked to 30% for 90 seconds immediately after a restart
cause: Cache warm-up period after restart, as documented. Not a failure.
resolution: Waited. Resolved itself. A second restart was nearly issued and would have doubled the outage.

symptom: disk usage alert at 80% on log-aggregator-03
cause: Normal growth against the 14-day retention policy; the 80% threshold is mis-tuned
resolution: No action taken. Threshold ticket raised.

cause: Service restarted at 15:20 IST, inside the settlement window, dropping in-flight batches
resolution: Sev-1. Finance reconciliation, 37 refunds. Root cause was an engineer unaware of the window.

symptom: Elevated error rate, card processor reporting an incident on their status page
cause: Upstream card processor outage; upstream_status=503 present in our logs
resolution: Escalated to Priya, who opened the vendor ticket. No action on our side.

cause: Rolling deploy with too-short readiness probe timeout
resolution: Increased readiness timeout. No rollback needed.
